Good place to try most things in one place
Mar 2026 • Friends
While it's not on any Michelin guide lists, 
but we liked this place because:
1. They had a little bit of all VN dishes so it was easy to try little bit of everything.
2. Servers can speak good English and explain to us how to enjoy each dish.
3. Portions are small e.g. Banh Xeo (Vietnamese fried pancakes) here come in mini sizes, not the usual gigantic ones, so they are more manageable and easier to share.

It's right in town in District 3, there's AC, good seating and cultural decor, so it was comfy and easy to take nice pics for us ladies.

Delicious lunch with great service
Oct 2024 • Couples
We enjoyed shrimp and braised pork spring rolls and the Bep Cuon Combo 2. The food was fabulous and was more than enough for the two of us to share. The staff was so very friendly and showed us how to assemble our lunch with rice paper, lettuce, mint, basil, kimchi and the pork/shrimp pancake. The sauce (a mixture of the two provided...also demonstrated by one of our lovely servers) to dip in was so delicious I wanted to drink up the remains! I highly recommend this restaurant.
